evidence.name: Screen field: Add and set up wheels
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Add and set up wheels" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Add and set up wheels
sections.description: The spinning wheels users scroll to make their choice. Each wheel is either a List of text options or a Range of numbers; use Add Wheel to add more (up to 5 with the String data type, only 1 with Integer), then expand a wheel to set its type, options, and starting value. Each wheel's selection is saved as a variable you can reuse later for personalized copy or to route users down different paths.
